standard_references.evidence: The official registry codelist catalogue was fetched and confirms that the SDMX Global Registry provides a Codelists listing/export interface. The supplied excerpt does not confirm exact versions or code contents for candidate codelists such as CL_SEX or CL_OBS_STATUS.

The supplied official-source excerpt states that a codelist ID is the unique identifier for the codelist associated with a concept and gives CL_OBS_STATUS as an example for Observation Status. It supports SDMX codelist modelling but does not provide the actual report-category code mappings.

The shared reference catalog identifies UNESCO ISCED as the international reference for education level. The report states that education-level labels require ISCED mapping review, and no supplied external evidence confirms exact ISCED codes or version for Primary, Lower secondary, and Upper secondary.

limitations: The supplied external evidence does not confirm exact SDMX CL_SEX codes, versions, or definitions; report sex labels are therefore held as local candidate mappings rather than asserted as authoritative SDMX codes.
The report explicitly states that education-level labels require ISCED mapping review; no ISCED version or code mapping is confirmed in the supplied evidence.
The report explicitly states that wealth quintiles are survey-specific and should not be silently mapped to a standard income classification; only the three reported quintile labels are represented.
No authoritative unit-measure codelist or code values for Students and Percent were confirmed from supplied external evidence.
Observation status values Final, Provisional, and Modelled estimate may have candidate mappings to SDMX observation-status concepts, but exact authoritative codes were not confirmed.
The report does not state a reference area, so no geographic codelist is created.
The report is synthetic and provides limited methodological detail for category boundaries, especially sex total scope and wealth-quintile construction.

codelists.name: Education report statistical indicators
codelists.scope_notes: Local indicator list preserving the two distinct statistical measures described in the report: enrollment administrative headcount and lower-secondary completion rate. No authoritative indicator codelist was confirmed from supplied evidence.

codes.name: Enrollment count
codes.definition: Administrative headcount of learners registered on census day, reported by education level, sex and year.
codes.evidence_quote: Enrollment is an administrative headcount by education level.
codes.local_creation_justification: Created as a local report indicator because the supplied evidence does not confirm an authoritative education indicator codelist or code for this measure.

codes.name: Lower-secondary completion rate
codes.definition: Percentage of the relevant cohort completing the lower-secondary education cycle, reported by wealth quintile, sex and year.
codes.evidence_quote: Table 2. Lower-secondary completion by wealth quintile
codes.local_creation_justification: Created as a local report indicator because the supplied evidence does not confirm an authoritative education indicator codelist or code for this measure.
